metadata.intro: A Technical Artist portfolio blending game graphics engineering with interactive visual craft. The scene below is a stylized, lightweight physics playground designed to keep interactions playful while maintaining production clarity.

games.name: Gnome More Shrooms
games.summary: A cooperative mobile game that turns growing and delivering crops into the ammunition supply chain for tower defense. Rookie Awards 2026 Game of the Year Runner Up.
games.role: Lead Programmer; Art Lead (2D animation and illustrations); Technical Artist (VFX and shaders).

games.name: Summerfront Tide
games.summary: A cooperative wave-river traversal prototype where movement rhythm and atmosphere design are core pillars.
games.role: Design gameplay flow, optimize shader-based caustics, and set up water-state state machine.

games.name: Cloudline Relay
games.summary: Time-based puzzle race built around environmental particles and stylized VFX.
games.role: Built VFX library, authored effect presets for rain interactions, and authored UI/UX microinteractions.

tech.name: The PAIGE
tech.summary: A scene-led rendering study presented through original artwork and comparisons of volumetric light, texture mapping, depth of field, metal BRDF, and medium radiance denoising.
tech.role: Final presentation by Jacky Pan for CS 5630.

tech.name: Aquarium Zen
tech.summary: An AI-driven biomimicry simulation that recreates lifelike aquatic behaviors through procedural animation, Bézier curve interpolation, and a particle system.
tech.introSummary: This project is an AI-driven biomimicry simulation that recreates lifelike aquatic behaviors through procedural animation, Bézier curve interpolation, and a particle system. By combining AI behavioral modeling, procedural motion, and particle-driven visual effects, the project captures the essence of biomimicry in digital ecosystems, transforming algorithmic design into organic, expressive movement.
tech.description: This project is an AI-driven biomimicry simulation that recreates lifelike aquatic behaviors through procedural animation, Bézier curve interpolation, and a particle system. By combining AI behavioral modeling, procedural motion, and particle-driven visual effects, the project captures the essence of biomimicry in digital ecosystems, transforming algorithmic design into organic, expressive movement.

tech.name: Adaptive Waterline Surface
tech.summary: A stylized water shader with ripple propagation, specular shift, and shoreline blending designed for UI-like scenes.
tech.role: Led shader architecture and authored modular pass for ripple accumulation and shoreline attenuation.

tech.name: Leaf Motion Pipeline
tech.summary: A 2D/2.5D simulation toolkit to author stylized buoyancy and collision reactions with low complexity.
tech.role: Designed lightweight collision + drag interaction layer and tuned damping for non-chaotic motion.

tech.name: Shoreline Workflow
tech.summary: Procedural material library for cards, decals, and shoreline accents with artist-friendly controls.
tech.role: Set parameter standards, build artist presets, and connect render previews in versioned pipelines.

digital.name: Water Margin Study
digital.summary: A mixed media study of shallow water reflections and hand-drawn textures.
digital.role: Art direction, composition, and final retouching.

digital.name: Lilypad Character Sheet
digital.summary: Playful creature reference sheet with handcrafted color and stylized highlights.
digital.role: Lighting pass, material style pass, and final panel composition.
